resolvedFindings.title: Expired pass stayed locked after a canonically reverted acceptance
resolvedFindings.review: Unknown or pending acceptance remains locked after pass expiry. The verifier obtains the local canonical receipt through LocalEvm. A known reverted attempt can be cleared without releasing a still-usable pass. A pass whose validity has expired can release after the failed attempt is reconciled. Recovery reuses uncertain transaction identity and creates a replacement attempt only after a known revert.
